Knowledge Base Article Title: Standard Procedure for Account Verification upon Ticket Creation

In accordance with our IT policy manual, this document outlines the standard procedure to follow during ticket creation, particularly when account verification is involved. It is crucial that all support agents adhere to these guidelines to ensure compliance and maintain service excellence.

Section 1: Completion of Initial Checks
All incoming tickets require an initial assessment for account verification requirements. Upon determining that a verification step is needed, the agent must proceed with the next steps outlined in this policy.

Section 2: Verification Status Record
The status record of the account verification process should be meticulously maintained and updated in real-time within our IT service management system. Agents are expected to verify the completion of these checks accurately and ensure that no discrepancies occur.

Section 3: Execution of Password Reset
Upon confirming that the necessary verification checks have been completed for the ticket, agents are authorized to proceed with initiating a password reset request on behalf of the account holder. The precise steps involved in triggering this action shall be adhered to strictly.

Section 4: Authority and Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
The execution of these procedures is anchored in our standard operating procedure (SOP) and approved IT policies, ensuring that all actions taken by support agents are within the scope of their authority and align with organizational standards.

Agents are reminded to handle each ticket meticulously, paying close attention to the requirements outlined above. The adherence to these guidelines not only ensures a positive service experience for our users but also maintains the integrity of our IT service delivery processes.
